overview_description.description:
Lernit is a SaaS that offers a learning experience platform system for organizations that seek to develop their staff through relevant micro-content, effectively, and available at any time through any device. It utilizes and provides its user with the development of different skills through short and engaging learning courses, instead of the traditional long content modules.

The company was founded in 2017 and headquartered in Nuevo Leon, Mexico.

product.name: lapzo Platform
product.description: Lapzo Platform is an enterprise SaaS suite for goal setting, performance management, feedback, and micro-learning content delivery.

product.name: Development by Competencies
product.description: A tool to define, diagnose, and develop the competencies required for each role within an organization.

product.name: Lapzo Mobile App
product.description: Lapzo Mobile App is a mobile workspace for accessing micro-learning modules and completing short training activities on the go.

product.name: Training and Learning
product.description: A learning management system (LMS) that enables easy course creation, personalized learning paths, and mobile access for employee training.

product.name: Evaluations
product.description: A module to create and manage employee evaluations, including 360-degree feedback and competency assessments, with real-time progress monitoring.

product.name: Climate Surveys
product.description: Customizable surveys to measure and analyze employee engagement and workplace climate with real-time data and automated follow-ups.
